WITH flagged_profiles AS (
    SELECT sp."SECURITY_TRACE" as sec_trace
    FROM "DataProfile" dp
    JOIN "DataFlow" df ON dp."Flow_Sign" = df."RecordRegistry"
    JOIN "SecurityProfile" sp ON dp."profileTrace" = sp."profile_key"
    WHERE 
        dp."vol_gb" * CASE 
            WHEN df.flow_overview->'classification'->>'sensitivity_level' IN ('High', 'Critical') THEN 3
            WHEN df.flow_overview->'classification'->>'sensitivity_level' = 'Medium' THEN 2
            ELSE 1
        END > 100
        AND CASE 
            WHEN sp.enc_state = 'Full' AND sp.acl_state = 'Strong' THEN 3
            WHEN sp.enc_state = 'Full' OR sp.acl_state = 'Strong' THEN 2
            ELSE 1
        END < 2
)

    sp."profile_key",
    rm.risk_management_profile->'assessment'->>'risk_score' as risk_score
FROM "SecurityProfile" sp
JOIN "RiskManagement" rm ON sp."RISKKEY" = rm."RISKTRACE"
WHERE sp."SECURITY_TRACE" IN (SELECT sec_trace FROM flagged_profiles);
